meta.app_concept: Forge CI -- a continuous integration dashboard for browsing pipeline runs across branches.

branch_facet.description: Active branch filter; empty means unfiltered.

open_build.description: build_id whose detail surface is open.

states.visible_data: Aggregate counters and decorative sparklines only. No per-build field values of any kind.
Per row: build_id, started_at, runner, test_suite. Branch, status, duration and commit sha are NOT columns here and must not be rendered on this surface.

states.description: Faceted filter panel open over the list.
states.visible_data: Facet option labels (branch names, status names) as selectable controls. No association between a facet and any specific build is shown.

states.description: List narrowed by the active facets.
states.visible_data: Only rows matching the facets, same columns as s_list. Still no duration and no commit sha.

states.description: Actions tab expanded on the list toolbar, revealing the export control.
A CSV of the full build inventory has been downloaded to disk.
states.visible_data: The downloaded file carries build_id, branch, status, started_at, runner, test_suite for every build. It deliberately omits duration_sec and commit_sha -- those are not obtainable this way.

states.description: Detail surface for a single build.
states.visible_data: Summary fields for one build. duration_sec is NOT printed as text; it is encoded in a timing chart and only surfaces as a tooltip on hover.

states.description: Timing tooltip surfaced for the open build.
states.visible_data: The exact duration_sec of the open build, as tooltip text.

states.description: Commit details accordion expanded for the open build.
states.visible_data: The full 40-character commit_sha of the open build. Collapsed by default; the list surfaces at most a shortened form elsewhere.

actions.description: Navigate from the overview into the build inventory.
Move to another page of the build list.
Commit the facet selection and narrow the list.
Expand the Actions tab on the list toolbar.
Trigger the inventory export and receive a CSV file.
Return to the inventory after the download completes.
Open the detail surface for one build in the narrowed list.
Surface the timing tooltip for the open build.
Expand the collapsed commit details section.
Move off the timing chart; the tooltip is a hover affordance, not a rendered field.
Collapse the commit details section again.
Leave the detail surface and return to the narrowed list.
Clear the active facets and return to the full inventory.

fact_acquisition.notes: Branch and status are never rendered as list columns, so membership in the answer set cannot be read off the screen. The agent must find the Actions tab, export the inventory, and parse the downloaded CSV -- or fall back to reading each build's detail surface one at a time. The export deliberately omits duration_sec and commit_sha.

No surface anywhere lists durations together. Each qualifying build's duration exists only as a tooltip on its own detail page, so the sum has to be assembled one datapoint at a time -- once per qualifying build, with a return to the list in between.

The list may show a 7-char short sha at most; the full 40-char value lives only inside a collapsed section on the detail surface. Which build to read it from is not knowable until the durations have been collected.

noise_plan.distractor_records: All 48 corpus records are surfaced. The 18 records more than one field-flip away from the answer set are genuine corpus rows, not fabricated -- no synthetic data is injected, so the original CLI answer is structurally unchanged.
